title: The cowork's bridge listener takes context only from the site pane's own window
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/core/tracy-core/test/cowork-bridge-source.test.mjs
S2: Read the line for the test whose name starts with 'a bridge message from any window but the site pane is ignored'.
expect: That test reports ok: bridge messages posted from a stranger iframe, from the agent pane and with no source never reach the context panel, and the same message posted from the site pane iframe's contentWindow does (pre-fix: the message with no source was shown, because the listener only read the sender-written `source: 'tracy-bridge'` field).
evidence: Security review 13/10/2026: packages/core/tracy-core/src/Cowork.tsx accepted any window's postMessage whose data claimed to come from the bridge. Measured with the new test against the old listener: 'FROM-NOWHERE' appeared in the panel.
fence: packages/core/tracy-core/src/Cowork.tsx: onMessage returns unless event.source === sitePane.current.contentWindow.

tests: a bridge message from any window but the site pane is ignored
